SELECT
    round(
        (avg(CASE WHEN d.IsHoliday = 'true' THEN fs.SalesAmount END) -
         avg(CASE WHEN d.IsHoliday = 'false' THEN fs.SalesAmount END)) /
         avg(CASE WHEN d.IsHoliday = 'false' THEN fs.SalesAmount END) * 100,
        2
    ) AS holiday_vs_regular_pct_diff
FROM retail.FactSales fs
JOIN retail.DimDate d ON fs.DateKey = d.DateKey
